title: Refine pipeline: Haiku refines one prompt at a time, Opus checks coverage, the session page shows it

chat.text: A node queue runs one Haiku minion per past prompt, a few at a time, each with a lean brief, writing the structured and refined prompt as cards that cite and deep-link the raw prompt. An Opus mastermind scores ten products for dropped details and tightens the brief until coverage holds. The session detail page gets a Coverage tab: every ask found, its status, a click-through to the raw line, and a coverage score. Asks repeated in three sessions get promoted to a module's architecture.md.
